description: SalesFlow CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management platform designed to help sales teams manage leads, customers, follow-ups, and sales performance.

features.name: Lead Management
features.description: Track, organize, and manage leads throughout the sales pipeline.

features.name: Automated Follow-ups
features.description: Create automated follow-up reminders so sales representatives do not miss potential customers.

features.name: Sales Analytics
features.description: Monitor sales performance using dashboards and reports.

features.name: Customer Management
features.description: Store and manage customer information in one centralized location.

features.name: Sales Pipeline
features.description: Visualize deals and track them through different stages of the sales process.
